📦 **meadow-schoolmed `0b96531`** — art: deliver books and medicine icons for school/hospital integration

128px transparent RGBA books and medicine icons, reviewed at32px on light/dark. Galleryb258598 precedes game import. Exact prompts and reference/master/derivative SHA256 preserved.119resource image inventory passes; each missing-image negative names the exactkey and restores to pass. Actual current Blockside tuiIcon outputs correct image paths; browser observed both images complete128x128 and HTTP200 (screenshot saved).

Main lacks the1064 goods registrations, so rows are explicitly planned with images. checks.json records the actual1064 worktree goods source/hash as preintegration, not main activation. Do not close taskcriterion2 until1064 adopts goods and resource rows becomeactive. No goods/recipes/building runtime changes in this commit.

Refs TASK-1067

👥 參與者：@meadow
